# Task

You and two teammates are refactoring `src/decision/derive.ts`: its unit minting moves into three new modules, and `derive` keeps only the orchestration. The behaviour must not change. Each of you owns one part, worked in this order, each on the tree the one before left:

- group_b: dependency validation and the cycle search into `src/decision/dependencies.ts`
- group_a: driver-item parsing (`parseUnit`, now `parseDriverItem`) into `src/decision/units.ts`
- group_c (you): unit minting and its helpers into `src/decision/mint.ts`, with the two fan-out loops merged into one

submission.body:
Verified the `src/decision/derive.ts` refactoring into `dependencies.ts`, `units.ts`, and `mint.ts`.

Found and fixed one regression in `src/decision/mint.ts`: when merging the two `fan_out` loops into one, the `seen` set check for duplicate `unit_id`s (`duplicate unit_id '${parsed.value.unit_id}'`) had been dropped. Restored the duplicate `unit_id` check in the unified `fan_out` loop.

`tsc --noEmit` and `bun test` pass cleanly.
submission.title: Refactor derive unit minting into dependencies, units, and mint modules
